_doc: G162 — how many videos the copied prompt says are waiting after a hand-off: every pick the queue leaves queued (a new, queued or failed row) plus every queued row not picked; a pick an agent already claimed stays claimed and is not waiting. `rows` maps a video's index to its queue state before the hand-off; `picks` are indices. Read by test_video_queue.py (video_queue.handoff) and VideoTests.swift (VideoRunModel.waitingCount).

cases.name: a claimed pick, a queued bystander, a new pick
a failed pick is queued again
a failed bystander is not waiting
